name: Pond0x PNDX public directTransfer
summary: The Pond0x (PNDX) token 0x1d4214081985ad20aa3ca93a2206ae792635cbec kept solady's mock helpers directTransfer(from, to, amount) and directSpendAllowance as public functions with no access control. directTransfer calls _transfer(from, to, amount) for any from, so anyone could move anyone's PNDX. About four hours after launch, 1,431 accounts made 7,778 such transfers out of 2,248 other holders and sold the tokens into the Uniswap PNDX/WETH pools. Those accounts' transactions took a net 81.029522709579604392 WETH out of the pools.

loss.notes: Stolen PNDX has no reliable USD mark: all PNDX/WETH pools together held at most about 18.6 WETH, so the reported 2.2M USD (SlowMist) is notional token value. The record measures the value the takers realised instead. Takers are the 1,431 EOAs with at least one successful direct directTransfer (0xf83d1791) whose from differs from msg.sender (7,778 calls, blocks 17792696-25611089, from the token's complete Etherscan txlist). Pools are Uniswap V2 0xa02b1596c48ec451482414e59c3c9895e06a2cc3 and V3 0xab19731eba97938c12f6fd7cf395fd6a414b556d (0.05%), 0x2ab3af4e9e69c29efc5b89be55e43077a07525e9 (0.3%) and 0x702747ac260e54b5511c311610c5e55951e47406 (1%). Over blocks 17792696-17900000, summing WETH Transfer logs into and out of the pools in the 1,202 transactions sent by takers gives net -81.029522709579604392 WETH (gross outflows -98.763772269177). The same pools gained +82.393523181233881890 WETH from other senders. This net figure is a lower bound on value taken: it nets the takers' own buys and misses thefts routed through contracts. Valued at the anchor-time DefiLlama WETH price.

ageReset.description: directTransfer is public in the deployed runtime and depends on no configured state; the token has no proxy or code-selecting storage.

sources.note: Target: Etherscan-verified Pond0x (solc 0.8.17, solady Ownable + ERC20) 0x1d421408: directTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) public virtual { _transfer(_brutalized(from), _brutalized(to), amount); } and directSpendAllowance(owner, spender, amount) public, neither restricted. Created by 0x1a5808ea973d5d23df22d5a49e79febeff4c6faf in 0xdc509894 (17791604:119, ts 1690547891); eth_getCode empty at 17791603 and hashing to 0x957e0bf3...f33e (4,638 bytes) at 17791604 and 17792695; no proxy. Age = 1690561139 - 1690547891 = 13,248 s. Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs of the token's Transfer events over 17791604-17792696 gives 3,974 transactions. debug_traceTransaction with 4byteTracer on each, all of which succeeded, finds selector 0xf83d1791 only in 0xf63913a7 (17792696:9) and 0xca984d4c (17792696:160) and never finds 0xd30ed3b3. In the token's direct txlist the first successful directTransfer calls are those same two.

Anchor: EOA 0x2d3162890e0a81bb0f4a1f65e8878d20853f6216 called directTransfer(0x162870cb4d97855bdee58fd5228b3aef03dd8839, 0x2d316289, 0x1431e0fae6d7217caa0000000 = 100,000,000,000 PNDX) in 0xf63913a7 (17792696:9, ts 1690561139, status 1); log 0x48 is Transfer(0x162870cb -> 0x2d316289). The victim transaction cited on Twitter, 0xe455c103, is the same call pattern by 0xad0fc281 from 0xd24723f8. Loss method (source-5 and the notes): taker set from the token txlist (15,194 txs, paged by startblock); WETH Transfer logs with topic1 or topic2 equal to each of the four pools over 17791604-17900000 (12,456 logs); eth_getTransactionByHash sender per transaction. Pool WETH net before the anchor block is +7.137747952725968715. The last taker outflow is at block 17857705 (ts 1691346527), used as realizedAt.

limitations: Loss is a lower bound: the realised net WETH of identified direct takers, not the notional value of stolen PNDX; contract-mediated thefts and takers' gross proceeds are not counted.
